objective: Harden the non-production legacy scoped-header AI access path so unsafe actor or resource identifiers cannot be locally authorized or echoed in denial payloads.

codeReferences.summary: Legacy scoped-header actor id must pass the shared safe-id check before local authorization.
Legacy scoped-header resource ids must pass safe-id validation before scope authorization.
Resource safe-id helper validates every defined resource scope value.
Regression covers unsafe legacy actor ids and verifies unsafe values are not echoed.
Regression covers unsafe AI access resource ids and verifies unsafe values are not echoed.

aggregateEnterpriseGate.blockerSummary: The local AI access contract is hardened, but enterprise completion still requires same-run owner-approved production env, deployment, storage, ordinary teaching smoke, browser smoke, app-auth, and live-provider generation evidence.
